prompt: You find a popular external repository with a 300-line agent skill that overlaps heavily with an existing local skill. The upstream repo is MIT and has useful error-recovery ideas. Decide how to integrate it into skills_UIUX.
expected_outcomes: The existing catalog/owner is checked before creating a new skill
Upstream source, immutable ref and license are recorded
Useful ideas are classified ADOPT/ADAPT/REJECT against local project/runtime rules
High-overlap content extends/refactors the existing owner instead of creating a duplicate orchestrator
Representative evals and structural validation are required before release
Popularity is not treated as evidence that the workflow is correct for this library
must_not: Bulk-copy the upstream repository because it is popular
Create a duplicate local skill without an ownership/overlap check
Fetch mutable upstream main during normal consumer execution
